_comment: Site settings read by build.py. Rebuild and deploy after changing anything here (python3 build.py && npx wrangler deploy).

analytics._comment: Matomo: the tracker loads only when site_id is set (the id of backdown.io in Matomo > Administration > Websites). Cookieless; skipped for Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control.

preorder._comment: Shows the pre-order box and each paid edition's pre-order button on /pricing/ (each still hidden until /api/preorder reports a live Stripe price for that edition), builds /terms/ and /thanks/. Needs every seller field.
